subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: Should the Google Meet plugin expose a public transcript API whose retained transcript exists only in gateway memory, is lost on restart, and irreversibly evicts lines beyond 2000 entries?
rationale: The implementation can enforce this bounded model, but session transcript lifetime and persistence are user-visible product behavior that tests cannot decide.

options.title: Approve bounded runtime memory
options.body: Accept the documented restart loss and 2000-line eviction after integer cursor validation and live proof are complete.

options.title: Require SQLite persistence
options.body: Pause until transcript state has an owner-approved durable SQLite lifecycle with restart and cleanup proof.

options.title: Defer transcript retrieval
options.body: Keep the existing recentTranscript behavior until maintainers choose a durable public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded runtime memory
recommendation.body: Accept the documented restart loss and 2000-line eviction after integer cursor validation and live proof are complete.
